en.title: Sony Reportedly Cancels PS5 Heist Shooter Fairgame$ After Years of Silence
en.summary: The ambitious PS5-exclusive shooter, **Fairgame$**, has reportedly been canceled by Sony after years of development limbo. This marks another blow to the platform's live-service ambitions.
en.body:
After a prolonged period of radio silence, **Fairgame$**, the ambitious heist-themed shooter from **Haven Studios**, appears to have met its end. Reports surfaced this week, citing internal communications, that Sony has decided to cease development on the PlayStation 5 exclusive. This news comes as little surprise to those who have followed the game's quiet journey since its reveal at the PlayStation Showcase in May 2023.

The game, envisioned as a competitive PvP experience centered around online heists, has been conspicuously absent from public view for years. While gameplay footage did leak in September 2026, confirming active development, the lack of official updates fueled speculation about its troubled path. Internal testing reportedly revealed mixed results, with player feedback and retention falling short of Sony's expectations. Executives **Sean Decker** and **John Doyle** noted in a memo, "Combined with challenging market conditions in the PVP shooter genre, we have made the difficult decision to cease development on the game."

This move adds **Fairgame$** to a growing list of PlayStation projects that have struggled to materialize or survive within Sony's push for live-service titles. Earlier reports suggested the game was attempting a pivot towards an extraction-shooter model, similar to **Bungie's Marathon** or **Call of Duty's DMZ**, but it seems this change was not enough to salvage the project. The cancellation is particularly notable given the significant investment and development resources likely poured into **Haven Studios'** first major title under the PlayStation umbrella.

## The Weight of Expectation

For fans who were intrigued by **Fairgame$'s** unique premise and the promise of a fresh take on the PvP shooter genre, this news is undoubtedly a disappointment. The game was positioned as a flagship title, showcasing Sony's commitment to evolving its first-party offerings beyond traditional single-player experiences. However, the consistent rumors of development struggles and the game's inability to capture significant player interest during testing suggest that the vision may not have aligned with market realities. The competitive shooter landscape is notoriously difficult to break into, with established giants and innovative newcomers constantly vying for player attention.

## What's Next for Live Service?

With **Fairgame$** now reportedly shelved, the focus shifts back to Sony's broader live-service strategy. The platform holder has faced significant hurdles in this arena, with titles like **Concord** experiencing a swift shutdown post-launch and other ambitious projects, including **The Last of Us Factions**, failing to see the light of day. The industry continues to observe how major publishers navigate the high-stakes, high-reward world of games as a service, and Sony's journey has been a particularly closely watched one. Details on future live-service projects from Sony and its studios remain under wraps, leaving many to wonder what the next attempt will look like and whether it can succeed where **Fairgame$** apparently could not.

content_raw: Well, it seems like this one was only a matter of time. Sony has reportedly canceled the long-missing online shooter Fairgame$ after it went missing in the public eye for years, according to Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier , adding to a long list of canceled PlayStation projects this generation. Schreier said that “a recent test of the game with thousands of players did not deliver on the results PlayStation expected,” according to an internal email sent to employees today. First revealed at PlayStation Showcase way back in May 2023, the game seemed to be themed around online heist PvP gameplay. But it hasn’t been seen since, and this cancellation comes as little surprise, as rumors about turmoil in development have been swirling for some time. “While the test demonstrated strong operational excellence, live ops readiness and community engagement, player feedback and retention results were mixed and fell short of the goals we had set,” executives Sean Decker and John Doyle said in the memo. “Combined with challenging market conditions in the PVP shooter genre, we have made the difficult decision to cease development on the game.” Earlier this year, it was reported that Fairgame$ was pivoting away from the “heist” mechanic and instead focusing on the extraction game type, similar to Bungie’s Marathon and Call of Duty’s DMZ. It apparently did not work out. Fairgame$ , developed by Haven Studios, joins a long list of PS5 projects that did not make the cut this generation as Sony incessantly chased live-service success. Concord launched and was quickly shuttered, while The Last of Us Factions, a God of War game, a Spider-Man game, Twisted Metal , and more never saw the light of day from PS5’s games-as-a-service initiative. According to Schreier, “there will be no job cuts as a result of the cancellation,” and “Haven will instead move to support other studios within the organization.” The post Remember PS5-exclusive shooter Fairgame$?
